review_notes: I read the whole file and searched the rest of the KadisonSimilarity directory. Nothing outside this file uses finiteMatrixTestAlgebra, invariantStarRepresentation or matrix_entry_mem_test_algebra, so I found no downstream simp use to support a change. The file has one simp lemma, invariantStarRepresentation_apply. It is proved by rfl and rewrites the coerced application into `a.val x`, so it is a terminating, non-cyclic projection-style rule. It does not compete with the existing `@[simp] mapCopies_apply` in RectangularDerivations.lean. The `ext ...; rfl` proofs near hIξ and hIY could be argued to want extra simp lemmas for `mapCopies subtypeL` and `amplify`. I did not find enough evidence that this would improve actual uses. The `simpa only` and `simp only` calls are explicit and local. Membership facts such as matrix_entry_mem_test_algebra are better left unannotated because their LHS patterns are not natural normal forms. I did not run Lean, so any remaining uncertainty is about simp behaviour I could not test.
